data.name: Brizio
data.long_meaning: The name Brizio is derived from the Italian word 'briare,' meaning 'to brighten.' This name is a combination of the elements 'br' and 'zio,' which mean 'bright' and 'strong' respectively. In Italian culture, Brizio was a common name for boys in the Middle Ages and Renaissance periods.
